description: The bar chart illustrates the perplexity of two different pruning methods, Per-Output and Per-Layer, across various pruning percentages. The horizontal axis represents the pruning percentage, labeled from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, while the vertical axis represents perplexity on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10^1 to 10^3. The chart features grouped bars, with blue bars representing Per-Output and orange bars representing Per-Layer. For each pruning percentage, the two bars are positioned side by side, allowing for a direct comparison between the two methods. The Per-Output bars have values ranging from approximately 3 at 10% pruning to around 400 at 80% pruning, while the Per-Layer bars range from about 3 at 10% pruning to roughly 800 at 80% pruning. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than by pruning percentage, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bars. The chart provides a clear visual representation of how perplexity changes with increasing pruning percentage for both Per-Output and Per-Layer methods.
